Pharmacokinetics and herb-drug interactions of silymarin
HU Fan $^{1,2}$ , YUAN Hong $^{1}$ , HUANG Zhi-jun $^{1}$ , ZUO Xiao-cong $^{1}$(1. The Third Xiangya Hospital, Central South University, Changsha HU-NAN 410013, China; 2. School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Central South University, Changsha HU-NAN 410013, China)[ABSTRACT] Silymarin is a mixture of polyphenoic fiavonoids extracted from the seeds of milk thistle. It undergoes phase I and phase II metabolism and is primarily excreted from the body by bile and urine. Silymarin can decrease the activity of CYP450 and UDP-glucuronosyltransferase (UGT) enzyme. It can also inhibit the transportation of P-glycoprotein (P-gp), OATP1B1 as well as BCRP, and affect the pharmacokinetics of several drugs in vivo. Therefore, the risk of drug-drug interaction is high. This paper reviewed the recent studies on the herb-drug interaction for silymarin.水飞蓟素（silymarin）是从水飞蓟种子中萃取的黄酮类混合物 $^{[1]}$ ，由分子式为 $C_{25}H_{22}O_{10}$ 的4种同分异构体组成，包括水飞蓟宾(silybin, silibinin)、异水飞蓟宾(isosilybin, isosilibinin)、水飞蓟宁(silidianin)和水飞蓟亭(silichristin)。其中水飞蓟宾的活性与含量最高（60%\~70%），天然存在的水飞蓟宾是一组非对映异构体A和B，构型分别为2R, 3R, 10R, 11R和2R, 3R, 10S, 11S，比例为 1:1 $^{[2]}$ 。水飞蓟宾由 1 分子紫杉叶素(taxifolin, 类黄酮组分)和 1 分子松柏醇(coniferyl alcohol, 木脂素组分)构成，因此水飞蓟素又名类黄酮木脂素(flavonolignans) $^{[3]}$ 。水飞蓟素有抗纤维化、抗炎和免疫调节等作用，常用于肝胆功能紊乱、肝炎等肝胆疾病的治疗 $^{[4]}$ 。且可阻止基因损伤、增加肝细胞蛋白合成、降低致癌物活性，因此也用于化学治疗(化疗)增效 $^{[5]}$ 。是多种酶与转运体的抑制剂，可改变多种药物的药动学参数，易导致药物相互作用。本文旨在介绍水飞蓟素与其他药物的药动学相互作用及机制。
